payload.title: A graphql_operation_drift finding cites the operation's own file for both evidence sides, so FindingSeed.plan_text keys its side names by path and one name overwrites the other: the plan tells the implementer to change `supergraph`, or drops the operation name for an unnamed operation.
evidence: tools/aria-poc/seed_drift_findings.py:176-184 (ui and source sides both use entry['file'], declared names are the operation and 'supergraph')
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/finding_subject.py:166-175 (subject_sides returns the sorted (path, name) pairs, two pairs for one path)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/finding_seed.py:121-136 (named = {path: name} collapses the pairs, the later one wins, and the text names that one)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/finding_seed.py:274 (sides filtered by _SIDE_NAME_RE, so the name '(anonymous)' is dropped)
tools/aria-poc/invariants/test_seed_graphql_operation_drift.py:211-223 (the only mint test asserts the class and the cited file, never the plan text)
payload.rule_violated: ADR-0018 D6 plan text names only the subject's own ids, paths and identifiers (finding_seed.py module docstring); the plan must name what the key identifies.
payload.notes: Reproduced by constructing FindingSeed from the sorted sides at the revision: for operation GetChemicals and for chemicals the key change reads 'change `supergraph` (X, X) so the graphql_operation_drift sides agree'; for weatherForecast it names the operation; for an anonymous operation only `supergraph` remains. Path and write scope stay correct, but the unattended F plan an implementer reads points at an identifier that does not exist in the file, and no test renders plan text for this class. Close condition: Render the text from every name of a path (join them) or cite the contract side at a ref that is not the operation's file, and add a kernel test that seeds graphql_operation_drift records for a PascalCase, a lowercase, a late-sorting and an anonymous operation and asserts that the key change and summary name the operation. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 5). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
